rules.statement: In a testamentary action, the proper stage for determining whether property alleged to belong to a testator should be excluded from the estate is not when conflicting claims to administration are being considered by the Court.
rules.supporting_quote: "The short point arising on this appeal relates to the proper stage at which the District Court should, in the course of a testamentary action, adjudicate upon a dispute as to whether property alleged to belong to a testator should be excluded from the property of the estate on the ground that it is property belonging to another."
